meta_title: Cost & Payment — TrueNorth Living Sober Living Homes
meta_description: What sober living costs at TrueNorth Living in North Texas: rates by house, what's included, what insurance does and doesn't cover, and financial assistance.
hero_title: What it costs, in plain numbers.
hero_body: Most people asking this question are doing math in a parking lot. So here it is up front, with nothing buried below the fold.
rates_note: Rates are per person and set per house. Payment can be monthly, every two weeks, or weekly — whichever fits how you get paid.
rates_pending_body: Exact rates aren't final yet and will depend on the house. We're planning on somewhere between these numbers.
rates_flex: Flexible payment — monthly, every two weeks, or weekly if that works better for you. Ask and we'll set it up.
included: Your bed, furnished, in a shared or private room depending on the house
All utilities — water, electric, gas, internet
Basic household supplies and cleaning products
Help getting to work, meetings, and appointments
not_included: Clinical treatment, therapy, or medication (we help you connect to these — we don't provide them)
insurance_body: Sober living is housing, not clinical treatment, so health insurance usually does not pay for it directly. Be skeptical of any operator who tells you otherwise. What insurance can cover is the clinical care you receive while living here — outpatient programs, counseling, and medication-assisted treatment. We'll help you line those up.
assistance_body: Say so before you're behind, not after. Options we can walk you through:

assistance.title: Financial Assistance
assistance.body:
Recovery should be accessible whenever possible. We understand that financial challenges can make the transition into recovery housing difficult. Our team will work with each individual to explore available options, including flexible payment arrangements, community resources, and any financial assistance that may be available.

While funding opportunities vary and cannot be guaranteed, we encourage anyone with financial concerns to contact us. We're committed to helping individuals identify the resources that may support their recovery journey

assistance.title: Payment plans
assistance.body: We recognize that everyone's financial situation is different. For qualified residents, flexible payment arrangements may be available to help ease the transition into structured recovery housing. Our goal is to work with residents and their families to develop a payment schedule that promotes both stability and accountability.

assistance.title: Texas HHSC recovery support
assistance.body: Some Texas residents qualify for state-funded recovery support services. We'll help you find out whether you do.

assistance.title: Employment first
assistance.body: Residents are required to be working within three weeks. We treat that as part of the program, not a side quest.

faq_teaser: Still have questions about money, rules, or how admission works?
insurance_short: Sober living is housing, not clinical treatment, so insurance usually doesn't pay for it. It can cover care you receive while living here.
